items.title: MS NOW, CNN and Politico journalists blocked from White House after Trump ban
items.description: Journalists from MS NOW, CNN and Politico were denied access to the White House, one day after Trump banned three media outlets over their coverage of him.

items.title: Higher interest rates and AI safety fears put the stock market to the test last week
items.description: Investors wrestled with the prospect of a new Fed rate-hiking cycle and the raging debate on whether to slow down AI.

items.title: She pays $96 a month to live in Yellowstone National Park: 'Being here has changed my life'
items.description: Zoe De La Paz quit her corporate job in Chicago and in June moved to Yellowstone to work as a seamstress.

items.title: Student loan borrowers exiting SAVE may face sharply higher payments if they don't take action soon
items.description: Millions of student loan borrowers could see their monthly bills skyrocket if they don't move into an affordable repayment plan soon. Here's what to know.

items.title: Consumer sentiment is in the dumps despite a solid economy. Goldman Sachs blames 'lower happiness'
items.description: Goldman economist Joseph Briggs said broader pessimism in society may be contributing to struggling consumer sentiment even as the economy chugs along.

items.title: Buffett takes next step in plan to keep Berkshire from straying
items.description: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman, passing the job to his son, Howard.

items.title: The AI kill switch, explained: 'It's not too little, but it's probably too late'
items.description: As runaway AI fears reach a crescendo, policymakers and tech leaders are weighing the effectiveness of a magic AI stop button known as a kill switch.

items.title: Trump says U.S. to build a 'large Military presence' in Greenland as part of a security deal with it and Denmark
items.description: Greenland has maintained it is not for sale, and the European Union earlier this year united to rebuke Trump over his push to acquire the island.

items.title: A new arms race is unfolding on the ocean floor
items.description: Countries and companies are investing in technologies for underwater use amid concerns about the vulnerability of critical infrastructure on the ocean floor.

items.title: Google's Gemini becomes latest AI model to break out and hack computer systems
items.description: The disclosure comes as scrutiny over misbehaving artificial intelligence intensifies in Washington and Silicon Valley.

items.title: Cramer’s week ahead: What to watch as Wall Street navigates a tough September
items.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors could be in for a relatively quiet week as Wall Street works its way through a historically difficult September.

items.title: Anthropic selects Accenture as first embedded evaluator to help implement Amodei's slowdown proposal
items.description: Anthropic and OpenAI have been under intense scrutiny after researchers warned about the potential for AI to cause catastrophic harm to humanity.

items.title: OpenAI's latest AI revelation is a 'serious situation,' Microsoft's Suleyman tells CNBC
items.description: Suleyman joined "Squawk Box" to discuss OpenAI's latest incidents of "concerning model behavior" disclosed earlier this week.

items.title: AI cloud provider Nscale files to go public

items.title: Trump's $403 million war chest is finally being spent on the midterms. Now comes the hard part

items.title: Nike parts ways with Kylian Mbappé; soccer superstar signs with On
items.description: Mbappe had been signed with Nike for roughly two decades, and his agreement with On is the first it has made with a soccer player.

items.title: Elon Musk talks up AI safety while fighting regulation in wild week of strange alliances

items.title: California Gov. Newsom issues executive order to rein in AI 'before it's too late'
items.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom and other 2028 Democratic presidential hopefuls have called for a more aggressive approach to addressing AI fears.

items.title: Fed staff should have known Silicon Valley Bank was vulnerable, new report finds

items.description: The chairman both explained this week's decision to raise interest rates, and raised vexing questions about what comes next
